notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
[p]Choose JetBoy or JetGirl along with a choice of ship to utilize different starting equipment and abilities.

JetBoy has the original smartBomb ability, and JetGirl has the new teleporter :)

Also some bug fixes and general enhancements.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45095424/0c536df096cb2fa036d6099d6ad69cd218cbe252.png"][/img][/p]
